extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and editors seeking pages related to propaganda
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia category page that defines 'Propaganda' and lists subcategories and member pages; used to find and group articles that reliable sources describe as associated with propaganda.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of propaganda
rubrics_metrics.description: "communications aimed at influencing others regarding a cause, ideology, party or state."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as the explanatory scope of the category (the main article for this category is 'Propaganda'). No additional scoring guidance; serves as the working definition for included pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion criterion for category
rubrics_metrics.description: "This category is related to articles which reliable sources describe as being associated with propaganda"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies that articles belong in this category only if reliable sources describe them as associated with propaganda; the phrase signals a sourcing/inclusion standard for classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propaganda by country
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A classification dimension grouping propaganda-related articles by national or country-specific context. Count shown on page (74 categories).

rubrics_metrics.name: Propaganda by medium
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Groups propaganda articles by the medium through which propaganda is conveyed (e.g., print, broadcast, digital). Page shows counts of subcategories and pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propaganda by topic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Groups articles by thematic topic areas of propaganda (e.g., health, war, nationalism).

rubrics_metrics.name: Propagandists
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Groups pages about individuals or groups who produce or promote propaganda.

rubrics_metrics.name: Works about propaganda
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Groups secondary literature, books, documentaries or scholarly works that analyze propaganda.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propaganda in fiction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collects fictional works that depict, use, or engage with propaganda within narrative media.

rubrics_metrics.name: History of propaganda
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Groups articles covering the historical development, episodes, and study of propaganda across periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propaganda legends
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes folklore, myths, or recurring false narratives used as propaganda; groups articles labeled as propaganda legends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propaganda organizations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Groups organizations identified as engaged in propaganda activities (state or non-state actors).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pamphlet wars / Pamphlet war
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers historical and contemporary instances of pamphlet-based propaganda contests; listed as a topical grouping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pink-slime journalism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refers to low-quality or deceptive news sites producing propaganda-like content; included as a topic within the category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stereotypes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes articles on stereotypes that are used or amplified as propaganda; a thematic classification within the category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propaganda techniques
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collects named methods and tactics used in propaganda (e.g., fearmongering, white feather); serves as a taxonomy of techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propaganda theorists
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Groups articles about scholars, theorists, and analysts who study or have theorized about propaganda.
